basis: The February 3, 2026 release establishes the threshold crossing. J&J reported consolidated GAAP net sales of $343,778,000 for fiscal Q1 2026, ended December 27, 2025, versus $362,598,000 for the quarter ended December 28, 2024. The 95% cutoff was $344,468,100, so actual sales cleared it by $690,100. The earliest public date remains unresolved. I verified the CEO’s January 12 ICR presentation and located a separate on-site CEO interview, but could not verify the full January 12 remarks or deck. The USD upper bound below is the February 3 actual.

coverage.detail: August 5, preceding earnings cycle. The fiscal Q3 2025 release reported $454.3 million for the June quarter. Its fiscal 2026 discussion covered product launches and customer pilots and gave no December-quarter consolidated sales figure.

Recovered the issuer’s August 5 call transcript, including Q&A. The fiscal 2026 questions concerned handheld sales after the plant fire and prospective customer programs. Management gave no numeric bound for consolidated fiscal Q1 2026 sales. The webcast at https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/xwg6sjub returned a cache miss.
August 28 restructuring 8-K. The filing identifies exit or disposal costs and material impairments. Its index lists no sales-guidance exhibit.

November 17, immediately preceding release. The approximately 4% sales decline applied to fiscal Q4 2025, ended September 27. The $3 million to $5 million outlook covered fiscal 2026 closure and other charges. Neither figure bounds December-quarter revenue.

November 17 call. In Q&A, Fachner estimated a 1% to 1.5% sales impact from portfolio optimization. The CFO discussed reaching the full run rate around Q2. Management gave no upper bound for total Q1 sales.

November 24 CEO interview. The host’s dated summary and the issuer’s recap identify fiscal Q4 results, cost savings and product innovation as the topics. Neither summary gives a December-quarter sales bound.

The November 26 Form 10-K identifies revised bylaws as the subject of the November 25 8-K. The SEC index at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/785956/000143774925036158/0001437749-25-036158-index.htm was inaccessible on this check.

ICR’s program places JJSF in Mediterranean 5 at 2:30 p.m. on Monday, January 12, after quarter-end. The January 13 listing is a separate food-sampling reception. The program contains no presentation slides or sales figures.
Fachner’s post reproduces the issuer’s confirmation that he presented company strategy, performance and long-term priorities at ICR. The recap gives no fiscal Q1 revenue figure.

J&J’s event archive lists the November 17 and February 3 calls consecutively, with transcripts. It supplies no January 12 deck, webcast or transcript. The supplied SEC filing inventory likewise identifies no intervening ICR exhibit.

The organizer’s live event page now covers 2027. A search of SummitCast, used by another 2026 presenter, did not locate a JJSF session. The attempted conference-level URL https://event.summitcast.com/view/GC3Lpwomn4ZmhBu9nkP7aE was inaccessible.

Located a separate Exec Edge interview conducted by Jarrett Banks at ICR. The host describes acquisitions, margins and long-term growth. Its written account gives no Q1 sales figure and does not identify the interview as the scheduled January 12 investor presentation.

The interview’s Vimeo page identifies Fachner and uploader CorpGov but exposed no transcript. The host’s embedded player at https://player.vimeo.com/video/1157678870?h=9e695d40fa returned a cache miss. I could not verify the spoken interview in full.
January 16 issuer notice scheduled the February 3 premarket release and 10 a.m. Eastern call. It supplied no preliminary sales or quarterly range.

February 3 actuals. The consolidated statements of earnings give net sales of 343,778 and 362,598 in thousands of dollars. The segment note independently reconciles all three businesses to those same external-sales totals for both periods.
EDGAR accepted the results 8-K and Exhibit 99.1 on February 3 at 07:01:41.
The fiscal Q1 Form 10-Q followed on February 5, two days after the public results.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer release and SEC Exhibit 99.1 both carry a February 3, 2026 dateline, corroborated by same-day EDGAR acceptance. January 12 is verified as the ICR presentation date. Its public remarks remain unverified, so the record establishes the crossing by February 3 without establishing the earliest qualifying date.
